script_text:
Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now.
Mars is blazing in your fire element, and Saturn is squaring your ruling planet in your 1st House of Identity, forcing bold courage into disciplined action. Mercury in your 6th House is sextiling that tension, sharpening focus yet draining your patience.
In love, Venus activates your 7th House of Partnerships, so if single, your ideal connection mirrors your fierce independence, not your fear. If partnered, watch for stubborn silence masquerading as passion. You crave loyalty, yet need space.
Jupiter in your 10th House of Career is blessing unexpected income or recognition, but Saturn's square asks you to lead carefully and avoid overpromising.
An old mentor may offer a surprise opportunity. Your body may feel restless now, so channel that fire into physical training and deep breaths.
Follow for tomorrow's reading.
